options.label: Yes: a drafted review, curated
options.act: Sprint review draft generated from the record + digest
options.then: Draft each sprint review from the Record and the since-you-last-looked digest, for me to curate.

why: The Record plus "since you last looked" already know what landed, what was decided and what's carried. At a sprint's end the board drafts the review from them, and I curate the story. It stops being a document I rebuild from memory.
